description:
🚀 Team BIG DIPPER is a team of five passionate innovators exploring the intersection of space, science, and technology. With interests in AI/ML, Data Science, Python, Web Development, and UI/UX Design, we aim to turn creative ideas into impactful solutions.

We're looking for curious minds skilled in Space Science, GIS, AI/ML, Design, and Development who love innovation and teamwork.

Together, let's explore beyond boundaries and reach for the stars! 🌌
